scope: Controlled PAC execution of unchanged self-contained Darwin explicit scalar, 128-bit integer, one/two-word record and f32/f64 HFA calls, including register exhaustion and packed stack placement. Supplied prototypes, not automatic complete recovery. Indirect copies/results, arbitrary records, authenticated whole images, native Apple execution, signed exception unwinding and exact fault PC/ESR remain unqualified.
environment_post_model_changes: README.md only; model code and policy hashes unchanged.
changes: Fixed explicit Darwin ARM64 prototypes reuse the shared source ABI and AAPCS64 placement owner.
Signed/unsigned 128-bit parameters retain two physical words, odd register pairs and whole 16-byte-aligned stack spills.
Natural direct integer/pointer records, padded int32/int64 pairs and one-to-four-member f32/f64 HFAs retain complete groups across register exhaustion.
The public SDK retains natural named record layouts and opaque pointer identity. Both C routes retain actual member names and compile argument/result projections.
LLVM value grouping has one producer/projection owner. Logical record conversions capture each value once and exclude padding.
Argument definedness follows byte ranges only through copies and slices. Padding, expired SSA values and complete-width arithmetic dependencies remain distinct.

publication_integration.scope: Later dev changes only touch Android runtime, UMINV admission and related docs/fixtures. The full 608-case run remains bound to the earlier integration revision.
